description: FastAPI-based security/authentication module implementing JWT token handling, user validation, and protected endpoints.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Model representing JWT access token with token string and type.

classes.name: TokenData
classes.description: Model for token payload data, including username and scopes.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User model with username, email, full name, and disabled status.

classes.name: UserInDB
classes.description: User model extended with hashed password, stored in database.

methods.name: verify_password
methods.description: Verifies a plain password against a hashed password.

methods.name: get_password_hash
methods.description: Generates a hash for a given password.

methods.name: get_user
methods.description: Retrieves a user from the database by username.

methods.name: authenticate_user
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials against stored data.

methods.name: create_access_token
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with expiration and payload data.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the current user based on JWT token and scopes.

methods.name: get_current_active_user
methods.description: Checks if the current user is active (not disabled).

methods.name: login_for_access_token
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate user and generate access token.

methods.name: read_users_me
methods.description: Endpoint to get current user's info.

methods.name: read_own_items
methods.description: Endpoint to get items owned by current user.
